title: 군사학교 각종 증명수수료 규칙 / queue:ANNEX:0000:00:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
[Attached Table]
Schedule of Fees for Various Types of Certificates

| Type of certificate | Fee per copy | Remarks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Certificate of admission | KRW 100 for a certificate in Korean; KRW 150 for a certificate in a foreign language | For certificates not specified in this Table, no fee shall be collected unless payment of a fee is prescribed by another statute. |
| 2. Certificate of acceptance | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 3. Certificate of enrollment | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 4. Certificate of withdrawal or removal from school | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 5. Certificate of completion (or expected completion) | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 6. Certificate of graduation (or expected graduation) | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 7. Academic transcript | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 8. Certificate of degree conferral | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 9. Certificate of student records (school life records) | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 10. Certificate of employment | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |
| 11. Certificate of teaching experience | Same fee as above | Same remarks as above |

Note: The original fee and remarks cells apply collectively to all 11 types of certificates.
